header: Invite someone and you both get a reward
lead: Two to four steps in an ordered list. Name the reward in the lead, so readers don’t have to work it out.
note: Put the conditions on a linked page. Long small print here would make the invitation hard to read.

steps.title: First step
steps.text: The tile shows the step number. The ordered list gives the order to anyone who can’t see the tile.

steps.title: Second step
steps.text: The steps sit side by side where there is room, and one under another on a phone.

steps.title: Third step
steps.text: Four steps at most. A process with five or more steps needs its own page.

image.alternative: A quiet street of small shops on a weekday morning.
